name: strategy-genetic-optimizer
description: Evolutionary algorithm engine that breeds, mutates, and evolves trading strategies automatically. Use this skill whenever the user asks to "optimize strategy", "evolve parameters", "genetic algorithm", "breed strategies", "parameter optimization", "auto-optimize", "find best parameters", "evolutionary search", "mutation", "crossover", "fitness function", "population-based optimization", or any request to automatically discover optimal strategy configurations. Works with quant-trading-pipeline for backtesting and walk-forward-optimizer for validation.
